sector.narrative: Support for feminist, women-led and women's rights organisations and movements, and institutions (governmental and non-govermental) at all levels to enhance their effectiveness, influence and substainability (activities and core-funding). These organisations exist to bring about transformative change for gender equality and/or the rights of women and girls in developing countries. Their activities include agenda-setting, advocacy, policy dialogue, capacity development, awareness raising and prevention, service provision, conflict-prevention and peacebuilding, research, organising, and alliance and network building

Documentary film making on cyclone Remal & short research on SGBV, SRHR and communal harmony. Cyclone Remal has hit coastal area of Bangladesh 0n 28 May 2024. One of the project implementing areas Kaukhali sub-district of Pirojpur have submerged by water and the resident were living under water for three days. The project team have visited the area and talked to Young Women Leaders and women group members. During the visit the team visited their house and provided them personal hygiene items. A short documentary has created on the damaged cause by cyclone Remal. Only a small amount (transcript and subtitle cost) was paid from project. The documentary film has created voluntarily by Naripokkho team, while this can be used as a resource for any study on climate change and its effects. The documentary film has shared in Naripokkho’s YouTube channel.A focused study was carried out in four project implementation areas outside Dhaka as part of the preparation for the national roundtable meeting with policymakers. Titled “Local Scenario of Women’s Rights and Protection,” the study explored critical issues such as violence against women (SGBV), women’s health, particularly SRHR, and the state of communal harmony in these regions.

• 2 modules- `Feminist Leadership Mentorship Training Module’ containing wide range of topics including the life experiences of women, gender issues, sexual and gender based violence (SGBV), human rights, achieving a violence free life, leadership skills and the essential qualities of a leader and `Law Training Module’ covering sexual harassment law, domestic violence prevention law and cyber security law, as well as skills such as writing general diaries, statements and filing cases have finalized during the year 2023 based on in-person and online TOT with participation of YWLs and project team. • 3 documentary films- 2 short and 1 long; capturing the essence of the year 2022 and 2023 project activities have been produced. Segments and excerpts from these documentaries were presented in meetings with duty bearers to showcase the Women Gaining Ground (WGG) project’s activities. • 15 case stories of YWLs activities from 5 project implementing areas have been video documented during the period of 2023. The video documentation portrayed the journey of the young women as young women leaders.
